description: Null Cable: three independent sections, each either passing a polyphonic signal through or giving its output no channels at all, which a destination treats as no cable rather than as silence

params.text: Glowing white, that section passes its input to its output; glowing red, the output is given no channels. A press toggles that, or inverts it while held when its gate input is patched

inputs.text: A gate that sets whether that section passes or nullifies, read as a Schmitt trigger going high at 2V and low at 0.2V; by default a high gate nullifies the output
The polyphonic signal that section passes to its output

outputs.text: Carries that section's input while it is passing, and no channels at all while it is nullified or while its input is unpatched

menu: Gate mode — what the gate inputs and buttons do: Nullify, a high gate nullifies; Pass, a high gate passes; Toggle, each rising edge flips the state

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
